about_the_game:
🎵 Fable Hospital Original Soundtrack 🎵

Dive back into the wacky and fantastical world of Fable Hospital with this unique soundtrack. Each track is crafted to accompany your journey through the most absurd and charming medieval hospitals, blending epic, fun, and mysterious melodies.

This special edition features the original compositions that bring each game level to life, from the fields of France to the hidden depths of Atlantis, offering a musical experience as varied as the diseases you’ve treated.

Includes the following tracks:

  • France

  • North America

  • Egypt

  • Denmark

  • Mexico

  • Hispania

  • Japan

  • Transylvania

  • Greece

  • Norway

  • Mongol Empire

  • Albion

  • Atlantis

  • Main Menu

  • Map

Let yourself be carried away by the magical sounds of Fable Hospital and relive its most iconic moments wherever you are.
